proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our closing in St. Lucie West moved up two weeks and the new house in Tradition wasn't finished. Rented a 10x20 online at 10 p.m., had the gate code before bed, and the whole house was in by Saturday noon.
reviews.name: Yesenia Q.

reviews.text: Backed the pickup right to the door. Three trips, no hallways, no elevator. The aisles are wide enough that my brother could turn the trailer around without a spotter.
reviews.name: Bartholomew Z.

reviews.text: I kept my late husband's oak desk and our wedding photos in a climate unit for a year while I decided what to do. Opened it this spring and nothing smelled musty, nothing warped.
reviews.name: Lavinia O.

reviews.text: Gail walked me down the aisle before I signed and showed me a 10x10 and a 10x15 with the doors up. I went smaller than I planned and it fit everything from our two-bedroom.
reviews.name: Desmond U.

reviews.text: Just a locker for my Christmas bins and the kids' school files. Cheap, dry, and I can get in after work because the gate is open till ten.
reviews.name: Rochelle Y.

reviews.text: Bought the boxes and mattress bags at the counter the same morning I moved in, which saved me a trip across town. They told me to put pallets down and load the heavy stuff at the back.
reviews.name: Ignatius F.

proof.guarantee: If the unit you reserved is not ready when you arrive, your first month is on us.
